heros.infro: William the 1st was the Duke of Normandy and later King of England. He invaded England with an army in 1066. At the Battle of Hastings, he defeated Harold Godwinson, this along with other revolts is known as the Norman Conquest. This was the last time England was conquered by a foreign power. As King of England he was responsible for the Doomsday Book, precursor to the modern census.  He died at age of 59 in 1087.
heros.name: William the Conqueror
